messages:
Priya: quick sync — need input on per-route cap + add-on framing for next quarter. customer asks for per-route throughput add-on vs large commit slab. where do we land?
Jamal: most enterprise deals we've seen prefer predictability. they like a 'dedicated route' SKU they can buy for search/ingest paths. simpler to sell than per-token burst math. :thinking_face:
Chen: technical tradeoffs: enforcing per-route qps on the router is fine, but true end-to-end latency SLOs need dedicated capacity or strict isolation. per-route limits + bursting will still cause noisy neighbors unless we pin capacity.
Maria: from finance POV, commits give predictable ARR. add-ons are great for upsell but risk complexity in billing. propose hybrid: small commit floor + optional per-route priority addon metered by peak RPS.
Priya: hybrid sounds reasonable. launch criteria we should agree on: 1) specs for metering (per-route peak windows), 2) console surface for customers to buy/config, 3) rollout plan for pilots, 4) legal/contract text for SLAs.
Ash: legal flag — if we advertise route-level SLA, contracts must include fallback behavior and credits. no surprise. also need data residency language if routes map to regions.
Chen: implementation estimate: router + quota service changes ~2 sprints; billing ingestion + metrics ~1 sprint; console UX ~1 sprint parallel. can MVP by enabling rate-limited lanes with tags: `route_tag=priority` and meter `max_window_rps`.
Jamal: pilot candidates: AcmeSearch, FinSift, and VoxMedia. ACs: sustained 5k RPS route for 1h with <150ms p50. they want grace period for rollout.
Priya: okay — scope negotiation: minimum viable add-on = enforceable per-route cap + metered billing + docs. console and contract templates = launch blockers but can be part of GA week 2. agree?
Maria: agree on staging split: pilot customers billed on usage, with a credited migration path into commit if they convert. need price floor.
Chen: one more engineering note — KV cache eviction behavior will change under per-route caps. must add a metric: `route_cache_hit_rate` and alert on regression.
Priya: good call. add to launch checklist: telemetry (p50/p95, cost-per-token by route, cache hit rate).
Jamal: sales ask — add a grandfathering flag for existing committed customers so we don't force them into new SKU. small UI toggle should do it.
Ash: legal: add a short clause to the appendix for grandfathering and transition period (90 days).
deploy-bot: new RFC posted: /rfc/per-route-addon-v1 — please comment before EOD Fri.
Priya: next steps: Chen to post implementation PR with rough timeline, Maria to propose pricing tiers (floor + per-route multiplier), Jamal to confirm pilot commitments, Ash to draft contract appendix. I'll coordinate pilot kickoff. :thumbsup:
